effect_description_eng: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) Then, if you have a Digimon in play with [Angoramon] in its name or with [Angoramon] in its digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to your hand.
